# NOVRIX

NOVRIX is an open-source crypto sentiment intelligence surface. It aggregates on-chain and macro indicators into a single calm interface built for traders, researchers, and analysts.

## What NOVRIX Is

A web application that presents real-time and historical market sentiment data through interactive charts. NOVRIX collects data from public providers and serves it from the edge. No account required.

## Sentiment Intelligence

Market psychology indicators and macroeconomic overlays, including:
- NUPL (Net Unrealized Profit/Loss)
- MVRV-Z Score
- NRPL (Net Realized Profit/Loss)
- Fear & Greed Index
- Pi Cycle Top Indicator
- 2-Year MA Multiplier
- Bitcoin Halving markers
- Macroeconomic overlays (FRED data)

Data sources: BGeometrics, Alternative.me, FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data), CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap.

## Platform Architecture

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Data Layer**: Static export with edge-cached REST endpoints on Cloudflare Pages
- **Interface**: Dark-mode, chart-first reading surface

## Open Source

NOVRIX is open source. The codebase is available for audit, contribution, and self-hosting. The platform operates on community contributions and maintains no corporate affiliation or venture capital backing.

## Site Structure

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| / | Homepage — what NOVRIX reads and why |
| /sentiment | Sentiment Intelligence surface |
| /insights | Editorial content and market analysis |
| /about | Platform information and mission |
| /documentation | User guide |
| /methodology | Data sources and calculation methods |
| /changelog | Development history and releases |
| /donations | Community funding page |

## Key Facts

- Built and maintained by a single developer
- No external investment or corporate backing
- Free to use, funded by community donations
- All data is aggregated from public sources
- No proprietary trading algorithms
- No user funds are handled
- No KYC required
